message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and the adjacent Saturday–Sunday (or the holiday is observed on a Monday when it falls on a weekend).

| # | Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑weekend span | Notes |
|---|---------|--------------|-----------------------|-------------------|-------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | **Sunday, Jan 1** | Observed Mon Jan 2 | **Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2** | The holiday falls on Sunday, so the day off is moved to Monday. |
| 2 | Good Friday | **Fri, Apr 7** | — | **Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9** | Always creates a long weekend. |
| 3 | Victoria Day | **Mon, May 22** | — | **Sat May 20 – Mon May 22** | Federal holiday. |
| 4 | Canada Day | **Sat, Jul 1** | Observed Mon Jul 3 | **Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3** | Observed on the following Monday. |
| 5 | Labour Day | **Mon, Sep 4** | — | **Sat Aug 31 – Mon Sep 4** | First Monday in September. |
| 6 | Thanksgiving | **Mon, Oct 9** | — | **Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9** | Second Monday in October. |
| 7 | Remembrance Day | **Sat, Nov 11** | Observed Mon Nov 13 | **Sat Nov 11 – Mon Nov 13** | Observed on the following Monday. |
| 8 | Christmas Day | **Mon, Dec 25** | — | **Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** | |
| 9 | Boxing Day | **Tue, Dec 26** | — | **Sat Dec 24 – Tue Dec 26** | |

### Quick Summary

- **January**: New Year’s Day (Sat Dec 31–Mon Jan 2)
- **April**: Good Friday (Fri Apr 7–Sun Apr 9)
- **May**: Victoria Day (Sat May 20–Mon May 22)
- **July**: Canada Day (Sat Jul 1–Mon Jul 3)
- **September**: Labour Day (Sat Aug 31–Mon Sep 4)
- **October**: Thanksgiving (Sat Oct 7–Mon Oct 9)
- **November**: Remembrance Day (Sat Nov 11–Mon Nov 13)
- **December**: Christmas (Sat Dec 23–Mon Dec 25) & Boxing Day (Sat Dec 24–Tue Dec 26)

These are the federal statutory holidays that produced a three‑day weekend in Canada for 2023. If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta, British Columbia, etc.) or a more detailed calendar, let me know!
